timeoutPrompts: Seraphine: ...Are you there? I hear background noise.
Seraphine: Hello? Did you freeze up on me?
Seraphine: If you're not going to speak, I have to get back to composing.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Seraphine: You picked up. The hall is finally quiet now... I wanted to ask what you thought of the draft I sent.

choices.choiceText: The melody is haunting. It gave me chills.
It felt intense. Are you stressed lately?
I'm still studying it measure by measure.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Seraphine: That means more to me than you know. Most people only hear the polish, not the weight behind it.

choices.choiceText: Play me the closing chord before you hang up.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Seraphine: Stressed? Perhaps. The stage demands perfection... but hearing your voice helps steady my hands.

choices.choiceText: Call me whenever you need a breather.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Seraphine: Take your time. True art shouldn't be rushed. Let me know when you reach the crescendo.
Seraphine: *soft piano chime over line* ...There. Goodnight, {PlayerName}.
Seraphine: ...I will hold you to that promise. Goodnight.
